review_comment: The patch expands group search to include display_name field when the 'displayname' parameter is present. While authenticated users can now search by display_name, there are no demonstrated authorization checks limiting which groups are searchable based on user permissions. Review whether group information should be accessible to all authenticated users or if additional authorization is required. If group visibility should be restricted, implement permission checks before returning search results, such as filtering groups based on user membership or site-wide privacy settings.

The patch expands user search functionality to include first_name and last_name fields when the 'fullname' parameter is present, using unvalidated user input directly in database queries. While Django ORM provides SQL injection protection, the lack of input validation on the search query parameter could enable excessive information disclosure through partial name matching. Implement input validation to restrict query parameters to reasonable length and character patterns, and consider whether name field searches should require additional authorization checks.
